correctness.rationale: Affine shear aligns centers without changing determinant multiplier h R^(d-1). Multilinear determinant absolute value is convex in each vertex, ensuring some maximizing simplex on the two bases. For each k+j=d+1 split, expand vertical determinant to a wedge of horizontal within-group differences; Hadamard wedge inequality and the centered-vertex singular-value AM-GM bound C_m s^(m-1) give sharp product C_k C_j t^(j-1), attained by regular simplices in orthogonal complementary subspaces. Ratios A_(j+1)/A_j=t q_j/q_(d-j) with q_m=C_(m+1)/C_m strictly decreasing yield strict log concavity, ordered adjacent-only thresholds; C_d~sqrt(e d) gives freezing at fixed t<1. Independent separate numerical determinant and candidate ratio tests d=2..16 checked all phases and transition counts, not universal proof. Note base-supported equality classification does not exclude additional lateral boundary maximizers.
